$comment: The capability registry: everything an agent can be given. The capability resolver chooses from this list; it cannot add anything that is not here. Catalog data, not settings. Each target's `keep` tools are always in its verify kit (the change must be provable on its surface); the resolver may drop only the others.

tools.$comment: What each verify-kit tool is for. The resolver keeps a target's tool only when the project and the task need it.

mcp.playwright: Playwright MCP: drive a real browser, click through pages, record video and traces
mcp.chrome-devtools: Chrome DevTools MCP: browser console, network requests and performance profiles
mcp.mobilebuild: MobileBuildMCP: build and run an iOS app on the simulator
mcp.androidbuild: AndroidBuildMCP: build and run an Android app on the emulator

cli.npm: npm: install packages and run the project's scripts
cli.npx playwright: Playwright CLI: run end-to-end browser specs
cli.lighthouse: Lighthouse: web performance and accessibility audits
cli.xcodebuild: xcodebuild: build and test an Xcode project
cli.xcrun simctl: simctl: control iOS simulators (install, launch, record)
cli.adb: adb: control an Android device or emulator
cli../gradlew: Gradle wrapper: build and test an Android project
cli.curl: curl: call HTTP endpoints and check responses
cli.docker compose: docker compose: start the project's services from a compose file
cli.docker logs: docker logs: read a running container's logs
